status: Underidentified from this source; no new knee estimator or physical domain selected
scope: Read existing public ledgers, reachable lookup helper and retained original-program command observations only. No saved-curve evaluation, capturedPCM access, media download/decode, nativeaudio generation, originalCPU rerun, synthetic algebra test harness, UI/host action or productionchange.

command_evidence.status: Existing-evidence command composition verified; no original CPU or audio rerun

source_mode_boundary: Mode00/unchanged source-note mapping and stable common volume are the existing recording assumptions, not measured wire/controller logs. All four final notes fall in accepted36..96.

unknown_common_volume.saturation: None for base14..17 plus u0..32; difference C39-C79=2 survives unknown common u.
unknown_common_volume.not_db: Integer command units; unknown A(C) prevents assigning1.5dB to the2-command contrast.

prior_cap_audit.domain: All use fixed18dB internalEG attenuation excluding TL/velocity/AM; rawRR4 cap through assumedrate/RKS law.
prior_cap_audit.not_compared: No total-attenuation-domain candidate or crossedTL/pitch evidence. The fits/calibration and mixed prior scores do not select the hardware domain.
prior_cap_audit.chronology: Earlier exact-tour Sine99 tail supplied calibration and TX81Z analogy suggested18dB; reused recording, not new hardware holdout.

definitions.C_n: Recovered pernote seven-bit level command including common volume addend.
definitions.E_n_t: Unobserved internal carrier EG attenuation, with arbitrary still-unidentified fast/slow rate/key dependence.
definitions.T: Symbolic total-attenuation knee, not a numerical hardware constant.
definitions.K_n: Symbolic EG-state knee, potentially key dependent.
definitions.g_n: Unknown static output/capture loggain at note frequency.
definitions.q_n_t: Possible time-varying effect/capture/overlap contribution to the observed component.

algebra.observable_model: L_n(t)=g_n-A(C_n)-E_n(t)+q_n(t). This separable loglevel model is itself conditional on the measured component behaving as one carrier.
algebra.plateau_relative_drop: If E_n(pre)=0 and q_n(t)=q_n(pre), H_n-L_n(t)=E_n(t). Static gain and staticTL cancel within a note; time-varying effects/overlap need independent bounds.
algebra.EG_constant_restricted_model: K_n=K for every pitch, so ideal relative knee drop isK; unknown rates change knee time, not that drop. This is a restricted testable hypothesis, not establishedhardwaretruth.
algebra.total_domain_model: Trigger when E_n(t)+A(C_n)>=T, so ideal relative knee drop isT-A(C_n).
algebra.exact_competing_EG_model: Set K_n=T-A(C_n) and keep the same initial states, fast/slow rate functions and output path. Then E_n(t)>=K_n is exactly the same condition as E_n(t)+A(C_n)>=T for every observednote/time. The full predicted curves, not only a knee statistic, coincide.
algebra.why_saved_curves_cannot_remove_counterex: Each pitch is observed at one key-scaled command. Pitch andTLcommand are not independently varied. Allowing still-unidentified key-dependent EG/Reverb behavior absorbs the total-domain dependence. The source does not identify A(C) or independently bound q_n(t).
algebra.not_a_hardware_claim: This counterexample does not assert that hardware has key-dependent thresholds; it demonstrates a permissible competing explanation that the present source cannot exclude.

overlap_limits.39: Prior same-pitch release can overlap; short-basswindows have few cycles.
overlap_limits.79: Cleaner same-pitch history but a prior67 secondharmonic coincides and bass39 tenth harmonic is nearby.
overlap_limits.75_87: 75=8*39 and87=16*39. Harmonic contributions/75retrigger prevent treating them as independentvoicecontrols.
overlap_limits.rate_evidence: Published rawRKS0 early/late audible slopes differ across pitches. Those observations do not identify intrinsic EG rates or justify assuming no key-dependent competing mechanism.
overlap_limits.endpoint: Prior frequency-specific endings do not identify EG cutoff or totalattenuation cutoff and occur after the earlyknee windows. No disappearingtail is used to infer theknee.

missing_discriminator.samepitch_TL_variation: Repeat one independently authored purecarrier at fixed pitch/rates/RKS/gates with several different verified levelcommands. An EG-only knee independent ofTL predicts the same plateau-relative knee drop; a total-domain knee predicts lower relative drop/earlier crossing when staticattenuation increases, conditional on unchanged EG initialization and capture.
missing_discriminator.equal_command_different_pitch: Cross pitches with adjusted rawTL/LKS so their final levelcommands are equal. This separates command dependence from pitch/rate/key dependence rather than allowing both to vary together.
missing_discriminator.independent_effect_and_capture: Separate Reverb off/on and Chorus off/on conditions, stable unprocessed direct-output gain, long voice-clearing gaps, single-note controls, actual command/gate delivery and otherwise unchanged rawpatch. The existingcapture kit is a starting fixture, not evidence that this has been measured.

decision.reason: Exact frontendlevel commands improve inputknowledge but do not identify the chip internal ordering, dynamic law or TLtoattenuation conversion. A domain choice would still substitute an unverified mechanism.
